project.description:
Caching Policy
For each study row: • data_ready=No • Skip downloading • Purge any cached file(s) for that study (so stale inputs cannot be reused later) • data_ready=Yes and data_processed=No • Refresh cache (download and overwrite) every run • Rationale: this is the active work set; you want the cache to match “now”. • data_ready=Yes and data_processed=Yes • Use cache if present (cache hit) • If missing, download once (cache miss)

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
AWS_CONFIG_TMP=""
cleanup() { local rc=$? if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then log "EXIT rc=0 (success)" else error "EXIT rc=${rc} at line=${BASH_LINENO[0]:-} cmd=${BASH_COMMAND:-}" fi unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN [[ -n "${AWS_CONFIG_TMP:-}" ]] && rm -f "${AWS_CONFIG_TMP}" || true } on_err() { local rc=$? error "ERR rc=${rc} at line=${BASH_LINENO[0]:-} cmd=${BASH_COMMAND:-}" return "$rc" } trap on_err ERR trap cleanup EXIT
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
# ----------------------------- # AWS CLI / S3 performance tuning # ----------------------------- AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION:-us-east-1}" export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
export AWS_RETRY_MODE="${AWS_RETRY_MODE:-adaptive}" export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS="${AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-10}" export AWS_PAGER="" export AWS_CLI_AUTO_PROMPT="off"
S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS="${S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS:-32}" S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE="${S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE:-10000}" S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD="${S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD:-64MB}" S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE="${S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE:-64MB}" S3_MAX_BANDWIDTH="${S3_MAX_BANDWIDTH:-}" # optional "200MB/s"
AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-10}" AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT:-0}" # 0 = no read timeout
DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL="${DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL:-4}"
write_aws_config_for_job() { AWS_CONFIG_TMP="$(mktemp)" export AWS_CONFIG_FILE="$AWS_CONFIG_TMP"
{ echo "[default]" echo "region = ${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}" echo "s3 =" echo " max_concurrent_requests = ${S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS}" echo " max_queue_size = ${S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE}" echo " multipart_threshold = ${S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD}" echo " multipart_chunksize = ${S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE}" if [[ -n "${S3_MAX_BANDWIDTH}" ]]; then echo " max_bandwidth = ${S3_MAX_BANDWIDTH}" fi } > "${AWS_CONFIG_TMP}"
log "AWS S3 tuning: max_concurrent_requests=${S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS} multipart_threshold=${S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD} multipart_chunksize=${S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE} download_parallel=${DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL}" }
aws_cmd() { aws --no-cli-pager \ --cli-connect-timeout "${AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT}" \ --cli-read-timeout "${AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT}" \ "$@" } s3cp() { aws_cmd s3 cp "$1" "$2" --no-progress --only-show-errors }
require_base_credentials() { if ! aws_cmd sts get-caller-identity --output text >/dev/null 2>&1; then error "No AWS credentials available to this Jenkins step." exit 253 fi }
assume_role() { local role_arn="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" local session_name="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" local duration="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
log "Assuming role ${role_arn} (duration=${duration}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)"
aws_cmd sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json"
log "Role assumed" }
reset_dir() { rm -rf "$1"; mkdir -p "$1"; }
wait_all() { local pids=("$@") local rc=0 pid for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do if ! wait "$pid"; then rc=1 warn "Background job failed (pid=$pid)" fi done return "$rc" }
has_wait_n() { builtin help wait 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- "-n"; }
# ----------------------------- # Prereqs + required inputs # ----------------------------- need aws need jq need csvcut need csvformat need tail need java
: "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs must be set (s3://.../Managed_Inputs.csv)}"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}" HEAP_GB="${HEAP_GB:-110}" PARALLEL="${PARALLEL:-8}"
REMOVE_CONSENT_JAR="${REMOVE_CONSENT_JAR:-jars/entity-generator-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-RemoveConsentZeroPatients.jar}" REMOVE_CONSENT_CONFIG="${REMOVE_CONSENT_CONFIG:-configs/RemoveConsentZeroPatients/application.properties}" DBGAP_MERGE_JAR="${DBGAP_MERGE_JAR:-jars/DbGapDataMerge.jar}" ENABLE_PREVIEW="${ENABLE_PREVIEW:-true}"
# ----------------------------- # Persistent cache dir # ----------------------------- CACHE_BEFORE_DIR_REQUESTED="${CACHE_BEFORE_DIR:-/mnt/jenkins-cache/dbgap/beforeRemoval}" CACHE_BEFORE_DIR=""
pick_cache_dir() { local candidate="$1" if mkdir -p "$candidate" 2>/dev/null && [[ -w "$candidate" ]]; then CACHE_BEFORE_DIR="$candidate" return 0 fi return 1 }
if ! pick_cache_dir "$CACHE_BEFORE_DIR_REQUESTED"; then if [[ -n "${WORKSPACE:-}" ]] && pick_cache_dir "${WORKSPACE}/.cache/dbgap/beforeRemoval"; then :; \ elif [[ -n "${JENKINS_HOME:-}" ]] && pick_cache_dir "${JENKINS_HOME}/.cache/dbgap/beforeRemoval"; then :; \ else pick_cache_dir "$PWD/.cache/dbgap/beforeRemoval" fi warn "CACHE_BEFORE_DIR not writable at '$CACHE_BEFORE_DIR_REQUESTED'; using '$CACHE_BEFORE_DIR'" else log "Using persistent beforeRemoval cache dir: $CACHE_BEFORE_DIR" fi
# ----------------------------- # Workspace (do NOT delete cache dir) # ----------------------------- reset_dir data reset_dir completed reset_dir processing
# ----------------------------- # Auth + job-local AWS config # ----------------------------- write_aws_config_for_job require_base_credentials assume_role
# ----------------------------- # Inputs # ----------------------------- log "Downloading managed inputs" s3cp "$managed_inputs" ./Managed_Inputs.csv
log "Downloading metadata_new_search.json" s3cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/metadata_new_search.json" ./metadata_new_search.json
log "Creating inputs.csv" csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed" \ Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv
# ----------------------------- # Cache policy: # - data_ready=No => skip + purge cache for that study # - data_ready=Yes & data_processed=No => refresh cache (download overwrite) every run # - data_ready=Yes & data_processed=Yes => use cache if present, else download once # ----------------------------- cache_path_for_study() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" local abv_lc stdy_lc abv_lc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" stdy_lc="$(printf '%s' "$stdy_id" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" printf '%s/%s_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv' "$CACHE_BEFORE_DIR" "$stdy_lc" } s3_path_for_study() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" local abv_lc stdy_lc abv_lc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" stdy_lc="$(printf '%s' "$stdy_id" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" printf 's3://%s/%s/completed/%s/%s_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv' \ "$S3_BUCKET" "$abv_lc" "$stdy_id" "$stdy_lc" } purge_cache_for_study() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" local dst dst="$(cache_path_for_study "$abv_name" "$stdy_id")" rm -f "$dst" "${dst}."* 2>/dev/null || true log "Purged cache: ${stdy_id}" } download_refresh() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" local s3_src dst tmp s3_src="$(s3_path_for_study "$abv_name" "$stdy_id")" dst="$(cache_path_for_study "$abv_name" "$stdy_id")" tmp="${dst}.tmp.$$"
log "Refreshing cache: ${stdy_id}" s3cp "$s3_src" "$tmp" [[ -s "$tmp" ]] || { error "Downloaded empty/missing: $tmp"; rm -f "$tmp"; return 1; } mv -f "$tmp" "$dst" } download_if_missing() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" local s3_src dst s3_src="$(s3_path_for_study "$abv_name" "$stdy_id")" dst="$(cache_path_for_study "$abv_name" "$stdy_id")"
if [[ -s "$dst" ]]; then log "Cache hit: ${stdy_id}" return 0 fi
log "Cache miss: downloading ${stdy_id}" s3cp "$s3_src" "$dst" [[ -s "$dst" ]] || { error "Downloaded empty/missing: $dst"; return 1; } } handle_study_row() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" data_ready="$3" data_processed="$4"
if [[ "${data_ready,,}" != "yes" ]]; then purge_cache_for_study "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" return 0 fi
if [[ "${data_processed,,}" == "no" ]]; then download_refresh "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" else download_if_missing "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" fi }
# ----------------------------- # Apply per-study cache policy (optional parallelism) # ----------------------------- study_pids=() active=0 use_wait_n=0 has_wait_n && use_wait_n=1
while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed; do abv_name="${abv_name%\"}"; abv_name="${abv_name#\"}" stdy_id="${stdy_id%\"}"; stdy_id="${stdy_id#\"}" data_ready="${data_ready%\"}"; data_ready="${data_ready#\"}" data_processed="${data_processed%\"}"; data_processed="${data_processed#\"}"
if [[ "${DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL}" -le 1 ]]; then handle_study_row "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" "$data_ready" "$data_processed" continue fi
handle_study_row "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" "$data_ready" "$data_processed" & study_pids+=("$!") ((active+=1))
if [[ $active -ge $DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL ]]; then if [[ $use_wait_n -eq 1 ]]; then wait -n || true ((active-=1)) else warn "Shell lacks 'wait -n'; falling back to sequential" wait_all "${study_pids[@]}" study_pids=() active=0 fi fi done < <(tail -n +2 inputs.csv | csvformat -U 1)
if [[ ${#study_pids[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then log "Waiting for per-study cache operations..." wait_all "${study_pids[@]}" fi
# ----------------------------- # Shared inputs (cached: download once if missing) # ----------------------------- pids=()
if [[ ! -s "${CACHE_BEFORE_DIR}/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" ]]; then log "Downloading HRMN_allConcepts.csv" s3cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/hrmn/completed/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" "${CACHE_BEFORE_DIR}/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" & pids+=("$!") else log "Cache hit: HRMN_allConcepts.csv" fi
if [[ ! -s "${CACHE_BEFORE_DIR}/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" ]]; then log "Downloading GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv" s3cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/completed/GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv" "${CACHE_BEFORE_DIR}/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" & pids+=("$!") else log "Cache hit: GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" fi
if [[ ${#pids[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then log "Waiting for shared downloads..." wait_all "${pids[@]}" fi
# ----------------------------- # Run jars # ----------------------------- [[ -r "$REMOVE_CONSENT_JAR" ]] || { error "Missing REMOVE_CONSENT_JAR: $REMOVE_CONSENT_JAR"; exit 2; } [[ -r "$DBGAP_MERGE_JAR" ]] || { error "Missing DBGAP_MERGE_JAR: $DBGAP_MERGE_JAR"; exit 2; } [[ -r "$REMOVE_CONSENT_CONFIG" ]] || { error "Missing REMOVE_CONSENT_CONFIG: $REMOVE_CONSENT_CONFIG"; exit 2; }
JAVA_PREVIEW_ARGS=() if [[ "${ENABLE_PREVIEW,,}" == "true" ]]; then JAVA_PREVIEW_ARGS+=(--enable-preview) fi
rm -rf ./beforeRemoval ln -s "$CACHE_BEFORE_DIR" ./beforeRemoval
log "Running RemoveConsent step" java "${JAVA_PREVIEW_ARGS[@]}" \ -Xms32g -Xmx"${HEAP_GB}g" \ -XX:+UseG1GC \ -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch \ -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError \ -Dconfig.file="$REMOVE_CONSENT_CONFIG" \ -Djdk.virtualThreadScheduler.parallelism="$PARALLEL" \ -Dprocessing.parallelism.level="$PARALLEL" \ -DbeforeRemoval.dir="$CACHE_BEFORE_DIR" \ -jar "$REMOVE_CONSENT_JAR"
log "Running DbGap merge step" java -Xmx"${HEAP_GB}g" -DbeforeRemoval.dir="$CACHE_BEFORE_DIR" -jar "$DBGAP_MERGE_JAR"
# ----------------------------- # Upload output (refresh role right before upload) # ----------------------------- log "Refreshing role before upload to avoid timeouts" unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN assume_role
log "Uploading result to s3" s3cp "completed/allConcepts.csv" "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/completed/allConcepts_data_analyzer.csv"
log "Done"
